2. This is the first application filed by applicant - Sulvant Morya apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.55 of 2022 registered at Police Station S.T.F., Bhopal for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of the I.P.C. and under Section 3D/4 of the Madhya Pradesh Recognized Examinations Act, 1937.

3. The case of the prosecution is that a complaint was made by the S.T.F., Bhopal against the applicant and others pertaining to certain irregularities in the PMT Examination held in the year Sulvant Morya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58633770/
1 2009.

sentences.text: The case of the prosecution is that the signature/handwriting on the OMR sheet was not the handwriting of the applicant herein.
Therefore, an F.I.R. was lodged vide Crime No.55 of 2022 under the aforementioned offences.

Apprehending his arrest, the applicant filed an application for anticipatory bail before the IX Additional Sessions & Special Judge, CBI (Vyapam Case), Bhopal which was rejected vide order dated 19.12.2022.

entities.text: Additional Sessions & Special Judge, CBI (Vyapam Case), Bhopal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Hence, the instant application has been filed.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant contends that the offence is of the year 2009 and the F.I.R. is registered in 2022.
That the applicant being a Doctor by profession would subscribe himself to the prosecution as and when required.
That, there is no chance of he escaping from custody in view of the fact that he is a Doctor.
The learned Government Advocate based on the case diary available with him opposes the application for bail.
He submits that this is a large scale racket involving various other persons including the applicant.
That he is required for the purposes of recording of his statement and for other reasons.
5. However, on considering the same, we are of the view that anticipatory bail requires to be granted.
The offence is said to have been committed in the year 2009.
The F.I.R. is registered 13 years thereafter in the year 2022.
The applicant is a Doctor.
Therefore, it may not be appropriate to arrest the applicant only for the purposes of investigation.
It would suffice the interest of the prosecution if the applicant is directed to appear before the investigating officer on specified dates.
For all these reasons, the application is allowed.

Applicant - Sulvant Morya is directed to be enlarged on bail in the event of his arrest in connection with Crime No.55 of 2022 by Police Station STF, Bhopal upon his furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer/Arresting Officer of the Police Station concerned on following conditions:-
(i) that he shall make himself available as and when so required by the prosecution,
(ii) that he shall mark his attendance before the Police Station S.T.F., Bhopal once in 15 days on Sunday between 11 a.m. and 6 p.m., and (iii) that he shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
7. The application accordingly stands disposed off.

(RAVI MALIMATH)
